body:
A run still names the model saved when the run started, rather than the latest value known for it. `solace_task.run_label` prints the stored `model` and the raw `used` id, so the Runs tab and agent note authors show an alias's first saved name beside a raw concrete id instead of one current label. The server has the same first-match problem when an alias's `used` model matches several entries: `board::agents.merge_from` takes the first entry's label.

- In `board::agents.merge_from`, when several entries run the same `model` string, use the later, current entry's label for an alias's `used` model, falling back to the id. Keep the alias as what the run passes to the agent.
- Give the components one run-label resolver: `used` when it is nonempty, otherwise `model`; resolve it through the current `/models` labels, falling back to the id. Use it in `solace_task.run_label` and therefore the Runs tab and note authors, and share it with Strategy's `plan.state_text` instead of keeping two rules.
- Show one label only: no requested model or raw used id beside it. A label refreshed after a model rename must update an already displayed run.
- Cover: an alias whose run reports a concrete model; a run with no `used`; an unknown id; a renamed label after `ModelsRefreshed`; and several entries sharing one model string where the later label wins.

Left out: changing which model a run uses, a new model-management UI, availability refresh changes, or changing picker ordering. This makes the existing run surfaces show the current name of the model actually used.
title: agents: run labels use latest model
